title: Tools
description: A tool's declaration and the result its call returns, as every binding exposes them. The session file stores the result as a tool_result block (message.schema.json); this is the shape a tool hands back before the kernel records it.

tool_spec.description: A registered tool as hooks see it.

timeout_ms.description: 0 or absent uses the default tool timeout; -1 means none.

background.description: The model may run this tool in the background as a tool_exec task; its input_schema then ends with the background property.

deferred.description: Loaded on demand when the request carries a tool search; an ordinary definition otherwise.

content.description: Shown to the model: text, image and document blocks.

structured.description: Machine-readable output for events and hooks; never sent to the model.
